prompt_bodies.implement.execute: Execute powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File sr-smoke/progress.ps1 exactly once in the current workspace. Keep waiting for this foreground process; it deliberately waits for external gates. Set the tool execution timeout to 600000 milliseconds. If the tool returns a running session ID, poll that same session until it ends; never restart the script. Do not detach it or start it twice. Do not modify other files or publish Git/PR. Use the injected environment as-is. Do not inspect or print credentials. This instruction is the entire task; do not implement the example spec/plan task.
prompt_bodies.implement.report: 根据已有执行上下文整理指定实施结果；只报告，不补做工作。注明依据，保留失败、未知情况、缺失和冲突。
prompt_bodies.publish: 将当前分支 push 到发布目标并创建 PR。用 git branch --show-current 取得实际分支，作为远端分支和 PR head。结果未知时说明情况，不重复创建。成功后给出 PR URL。
prompt_bodies.publish.report: 根据已有上下文整理指定发布的结果和 PR URL；只报告，不重新发布。注明依据，保留失败、未知情况、缺失和冲突。

config.description: Implement and publish a verified PR.

implement.execute.prompt: 读取当前 worktree 中以下路径的 Spec、Plan 和参考材料，完成实现及必要验证。
implement.execute.success_output: 实施及必要验证已完成。

publish.report.result_instruction:
Return one JSON object:
{"outcome":"done|needs_input|blocked","summary":"result"}
For needs_input add question. For blocked add blocker: {"category":"failure|unknown_external|permission|prerequisite","action":"action","error":"error","known":"optional","unknown":"optional"}.
For done include outputs: {"pr_url":"actual PR URL"}.
